restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes: one unkeyed BLAKE3 chunk/block with flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT=11, length 64, counter 0, standard IV.
Deterministic closed-form complement construction from public IV constants; no search, no random coins, no stored precomputed collision as advice.

Charged work includes straight-line message construction on a 16-register 256-bit word RAM, two verification compressions, digest equality and message-distinctness checks, and program/table placement under collision-frontier-v5 with C=222 (W≤310 non-compression primitives; T=2+310/222<3.397).

Construction solves all four columns in closed form (G0/G2 force C=D=0; G1/G3 force C=b, D=0 so the diagonal d inputs vanish), skips evaluating diagonal G5/G7 (literal zero message words), drops unused outputs; complement diagonals share intermediates across g and ~g; diagonal b1 rotates are taken from clean IV (ROTR 19) so G1/G3 B-outputs may use rotation AND elision; small public constants 0, 11, 64 and shift counts / literal 1 are immediates (table loads only IV[0..7] and F); chained masked double-sub and rotation AND elision are used only where modulo-2^32 exact (harshest tabulated reading without them: W=366).
Certificate blake3-r1-complement-pair is an organizer-verifiable witness of the same construction instance; it is not nonuniform advice and does not replace charged collision checking.
Claim is specific to 1 prefix round; the complement cancellation used here does not transfer to 2+ rounds without a new argument.
